question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing left winger, Dave is playing left back, Eve is playing right winger, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) goalkeeper
(C) left winger
(D) left back
(E) right winger
(F) right midfielder
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Player order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: cheerleader | goalkeeper | left winger | left back | right winger | right midfielder | benchwarmer
1. Gertrude ↔ Alice: benchwarmer | goalkeeper | left winger | left back | right winger | right midfielder | cheerleader
2. Bob ↔ Claire: benchwarmer | left winger | goalkeeper | left back | right winger | right midfielder | cheerleader
3. Alice ↔ Claire: goalkeeper | left winger | benchwarmer | left back | right winger | right midfielder | cheerleader
4. Claire ↔ Bob: goalkeeper | benchwarmer | left winger | left back | right winger | right midfielder | cheerleader
5. Eve ↔ Dave: goalkeeper | benchwarmer | left winger | right winger | left back | right midfielder | cheerleader
6. Bob ↔ Eve: goalkeeper | left back | left winger | right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder | cheerleader
7. Bob ↔ Gertrude: goalkeeper | cheerleader | left winger | right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder | left back
Claire is playing left winger, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
